description:
Persist a directional investment thesis (bull / bear / neutral) on a ticker. The thesis becomes part of the caller's private research diary; pair with `list_theses` + `score_thesis_outcome` to track conviction-vs-outcome over time. Pass `idempotency_key` for at-most-once semantics from a retrying agent.

**Use this AFTER** the agent has finished its analysis, not before — the thesis records the conclusion, not the question. Pair with `source_report_id` to link the thesis back to a published report so the buyer's thesis-tracking carries provenance.

Tier: all paid + free tiers (sample tier rejected — sample is guest access with no customerId binding). Flat 10,000-thesis anti-abuse cap per account (archiving frees a slot; never a tier limit).

conviction.description: 1 = low conviction (gut feel) → 5 = high conviction (deep analysis).

horizon_days.description: Investment horizon in days. 1 day–5 years (1825d). The grader uses this to pick the as-of period.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. If a previous `save_thesis` from the same user used this key, the existing thesis is returned instead of creating a duplicate.

notes.description: Free-form rationale, ≤4000 chars. Stored verbatim; trim before submitting.

source_report_id.description: Optional id of a report (from `create_report` / `publish_report`) that contains the supporting analysis.

thesis_at_price_cents.description: Optional snapshot of the ticker's market price (integer cents) at thesis creation. Used by future versions of the grader that mix in price returns; null for now is fine.

ticker.description: US-listed ticker. Case-insensitive — normalised to upper. E.g. 'AAPL'.

view.description: Directional view: bull (expect outperformance), bear (under), neutral (mean-revert).

visibility.description: Phase 3: 'private' (default) is owner-only; 'unlisted' is visible at a known direct URL; 'public' surfaces on the author's /[handle] profile and contributes to their reputation score.

name: save_thesis

_meta.description: Provenance envelope — data lineage for every MCP response

cost_usd.description: Per-call cost transparency. Omitted for subscription-only tools that have no PAYG-equivalent price.

basis.description: payg_charge = real agent-pay charge. payg_rate_card = indicative price, not billed.

billed.description: true = this amount was actually charged via PAYG for this call. false = indicative PAYG-equivalent value; your plan already covers this call for free.

data_plan.description: Access plan: sample | sp500 | pro | full

data_quality.description: Server-side invariants run on this response

fundamentals_as_of.description: ISO timestamp when the FINANCIAL STATEMENTS were last rebuilt in bulk. Use THIS — not `last_updated` — when telling a user how current the cross-sectional fundamentals are. The snapshot is republished on every weekday price refresh while the statements are carried forward unchanged, so `last_updated` can be far more recent than the numbers it sits next to. It is a floor for a single filer, not a ceiling: a filer with a live partition receives its filing, facts and ratios intraday (minutes after EDGAR dissemination), so an entity-scoped read may carry a filing newer than this; cross-sectional ranks (factor scores, earnings signals) refresh with the weekly bulk export.

last_updated.description: ISO timestamp when the snapshot was exported

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds this tool call took, measured server-side around the handler.

limit_warnings.description: Soft-warning array for partial fulfillment. Each entry carries a stable subcode + remediation.options[]. AI agents pattern-match on subcode.

payg_override.description: Set when this single response was paid for via the agent-pay PAYG flow — the rate-limit / depth-limit checks were bypassed for this call only.

pit_safe.description: true iff a zero-look-ahead point-in-time cut was applied to every returned figure

price_as_of.description: ISO timestamp when the price surfaces were last refreshed.

reset_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the window resets

truncation.description: Set when fewer rows were returned than requested — explains why and points to a remedy

outcome_components.description: Phase C fundamentals × price breakdown (fundamentals_score, price_score, price_return_pct, legs_used, basis, …). Null when not yet scored or scored without a breakdown; absent entirely on records graded before Phase C shipped — both mean 'no components recorded'.

visibility.description: Phase 3 visibility: 'private' (owner-only), 'unlisted' (known URL), 'public' (surfaces on the author's /[handle] profile + reputation).
